d: Jharkhand men jepiessi aur jeesaessi ki parikshaon men kathit aniymittaon, niyuktiyon men deri aur bharti prakriya men pardarshita ki mang ko lekar chhatr aandolan ek bar phir jor pakarne laga hai. jepiessi-jeesaessi riphorms manch ki or se ek taraph jahan 22 navanbar ko hajaribag men mahapanchayat aayojit karne ki ghoshna ki gaee hai, vahin dusri or budhvar ko ranchi men aandolan dobara shuru karne ki koshish ki gaee.
